title: Pure Dinomorphia
summary: Dinomorphia cards only, with generic staples. Every Dinomorphia Trap costs half your LP, and once you are at 2000 or less each one also banishes from the GY to stop damage. Dinomorphia Therizia Sets a Dinomorphia Trap from the Deck, and Diplos mills one. Dinomorphia Domain and Frenzy Fusion Summon using monsters from the Deck, so the deck makes Fusions on either turn. Dinomorphia Rexterm stops their monsters with ATK at or above your LP from activating effects, and can set their ATK to your LP. Dinomorphia Intact, the newest card, negates a monster effect. Dinomorphia Sonic negates Spells/Traps, and Dinomorphia Reversion copies a Counter Trap from the GY. Dinomorphia Alert limits you to Dinomorphia for the turn.
